sentences.en: For lots of reasons, I recommended her as your guardian.
sentences.zh: 出于种种原因，我推荐她作为你的监护人。

sentences.en: I had all reasons to recommend her as your guardian.
sentences.zh: 我有充分的理由推荐她作为你的监护人。

sentences.en: Never drive faster than your guardian angel can fly.
sentences.zh: 永远不要开得比你的守护天使飞得还快。

senses.zh: [法] 监护人，保护人；守护者
